BiblicalUsage: The acacia is the wood of the tabernacle: the ark, the table, the altars, and the boards of the dwelling are all made of shittim wood, and Moses makes a second ark of the same wood on the mountain. Isaiah promises it will grow in the wilderness, a desert tree turned into a promise.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the acacia matters because God chose a thorn tree from the desert for the holiest things Israel carried. I hold that He still takes the rough and the common and makes it the place where He meets His people.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
